data.summary: The eval directory contains the end-to-end evaluation harness, question datasets, preflight validators, and reporting tools for testing the intelligent agent's performance and accuracy against frozen expectations.

file_insights.name: __init__.py
file_insights.summary: Package initialization file for the evaluation module.
file_insights.detailed_description: Empty initialization file for the evaluation module package.

file_insights.name: derive_questions.py
file_insights.summary: Derives evaluation questions and expected answers from operational data stores.
file_insights.source_summary: Connects to database via load script and generates questions with expected metrics using scalar, revenue, orders, asof, and week functions.
file_insights.detailed_description: Derives questions and expected answers directly from ODS and dimension version intervals. It writes out questions to questions.json for testing.

file_insights.name: preflight.py
file_insights.summary: Preflight checker for validating semantic layer readiness before evaluations run.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines preflight checks comparing queries against frozen expectations in questions.json.
file_insights.detailed_description: Executes canary queries with frozen known answers before evaluation runs, ensuring the semantic layer and database are healthy.
responsibilities: Validate semantic layer health before evaluation

file_insights.name: questions.json
file_insights.summary: JSON dataset containing evaluation questions and their frozen expected answers.
file_insights.source_summary: JSON array of test questions containing IDs, categories, questions, expected statuses, values, and tolerances.
file_insights.detailed_description: Stores question definitions, expected values, tolerances, categories, and roles used in agent evaluation.
responsibilities: Store evaluation questions and expected answers

file_insights.name: questions.meta.json
file_insights.summary: Metadata file tracking warehouse fingerprint and generation time for evaluation questions.
file_insights.source_summary: JSON object with derived timestamp, fingerprint string, question counts, and notes.
file_insights.detailed_description: Stores metadata about the derived questions, such as the timestamp, fingerprint of the warehouse state, and total counts.
responsibilities: Track warehouse fingerprint and question metadata

file_insights.name: report.py
file_insights.summary: Generates summary performance reports from evaluation result logs.
file_insights.source_summary: Parses jsonl files, grades responses using grading utilities, and aggregates metrics by category and arm.
file_insights.detailed_description: Summarizes results from jsonl result files, calculating accuracy per arm and category, failure classes, token usage, and execution time.

file_insights.name: run_eval.py
file_insights.summary: Main script for running evaluation benchmarks against agent models.
file_insights.source_summary: Parses command line arguments, loads questions, runs agent questions through the graph, and grades results.
file_insights.detailed_description: Runs the question set against specified agent arms and grades every answer against the frozen expectations.
